title: Padma Awards 2026: 131 Recipients Announced
shortDescription: The Ministry of Home Affairs announced 131 Padma Awards on the eve of Republic Day 2026 — 5 Padma Vibhushan, 13 Padma Bhushan, and 113 Padma Shri, including 16 posthumous honours.
genZNote: 5-13-113. That split (Vibhushan-Bhushan-Shri) is the number combo most likely to actually show up as an MCQ.

sections.heading: What Happened
sections.body: On 25 January 2026, the eve of India's 77th Republic Day, the Ministry of Home Affairs announced the Padma Awards 2026 list — 131 recipients approved by President Droupadi Murmu across the three Padma categories, recognising distinguished service in fields from art and public affairs to science, sports, and grassroots social work.

sections.heading: Key Facts
bullets: Total: 131 awardees — 5 Padma Vibhushan, 13 Padma Bhushan, 113 Padma Shri.
19 of the awardees are women; 16 honoured posthumously; 6 in the Foreigner/NRI/PIO/OCI category.
Notable named recipients widely reported include cricketer Rohit Sharma and actor Mammootty, among others across art, medicine, and public affairs.

A distinct set of 45 'unsung heroes' — grassroots workers in health, education, sanitation, and community welfare, including from Dalit, tribal, and remote communities — were highlighted within the list.
The three categories: Padma Vibhushan (exceptional and distinguished service), Padma Bhushan (distinguished service of a high order), Padma Shri (distinguished service in any field).

sections.heading: Why It Matters
sections.body: Padma Awards numbers (total count and the Vibhushan/Bhushan/Shri split) are a classic, easy-to-verify GK/current-affairs fact asked almost every year — this year's 131/5/13/113 split is the concrete number set to remember for 2026.

quickRevision.oneLineDefinition: Padma Awards 2026: 131 recipients announced 25 January 2026 — 5 Padma Vibhushan, 13 Padma Bhushan, 113 Padma Shri.
keyFacts: Total: 131 — split 5 / 13 / 113 across Vibhushan / Bhushan / Shri.
commonConfusion: Padma Awards are announced on Republic Day EVE (25 January) but formally conferred at ceremonies later in the year at Rashtrapati Bhavan — the announcement date and the conferral date are different.

highYieldFacts: 131 total: 5 Padma Vibhushan + 13 Padma Bhushan + 113 Padma Shri.
commonTraps: Treating the announcement date (Republic Day eve) as the date the awards are formally conferred (a separate, later ceremony).
